correctness.rationale: Cyclotomic polynomial Φ_(p^m) has p equal-spaced coefficients, so equality of 3 positive and 3 negative root powers forces exponent-multiset equality for p>=5. All determinant permutations lead to duplicate restricted rows or columns. Prime-power pair valuations give exact ranks, counting gives exact B_m and finite census; inclusion–exclusion and summable tails prove the sharp 6/p probability and rank-one negligibility. An exact standalone integer-cyclotomic verifier passed 1,354,256 deterministic checks but finite tests do not prove the limit.

value.rationale: The theorem answers a natural complete-classification problem for three-point Fourier interpolation on all odd prime-power cycles. It gives a valuation-only rank test for arbitrary index triples, exact counts of rank-one and rank-two obstructions and a sharp characteristic-dependent asymptotic singularity probability 6/(pN); the invariant is motivated by robustness/full-spark interpolation, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
